item.title: Reading Happy-LLM: Preface
item.description: The emergence of ChatGPT changed ppeople’s perception of ai and brought about a transformative phase in the field of NLP. LLM, represented by the GPT, have become the mainstream research focus in NLP and even the broader field of ai. Preface LLM is actually a derivative achievement of the classic research method of Pretrain Language Model (PLM) in the field of NLP. The field of NLP focuses on the processing, understanding, and generation of natural language text written by humans, and has undergone multiple transformations from the symbolic stage, statistical learning stage, deep learning stage, pre-training model stage, to the current large model stage.

item.title: Tensorflow Identify Simple Captcha
item.description: CAPTCHA stands for ‘Completely Automated Public Turing test to tell Computers and Humans Apart’. It’s already possible to solve it with the rise of deep learning and computer vision.
